paragraphs: TOW stands for tube launched, optically tracked, wire guided, and the last part is the interesting one: the missile trails a wire back to the launcher, so the gunner has to keep the sight on the target until impact. It is a weapon that demands the operator stay put, which shaped a generation of infantry tactics.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the launcher system and its components as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $119 the set suits defence visualisation and presentation, documentary and news graphics, simulation, film and game environments. On sale since 2017.

Counter drone systems are a radar, a camera and a jammer bolted to the same mast, and they exist because a cheap quadcopter can shut down an airport. Detection is the hard part: the target is small, slow and flying where radar was never designed to look.

The model holds 335,506 polygons and 348,441 vertices, built in quads only with non-overlapping UVs, and supplies the defence system together with its radar set. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $119 it suits defence and security visualisation, airport and infrastructure protection presentation, news and documentary graphics, simulation and game environments. On sale since 2021.

A bird skeleton is a lesson in weight saving: hollow bones, a keel where the flight muscles anchor, and a fused spine that would be useless in a mammal. A chicken shows all of it in the animal people are most likely to have seen dismantled on a plate.
The model holds 83,962 polygons and 84,085 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, showing the skeletal structure. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $119 it suits biology and veterinary education, museum and exhibition work, scientific illustration, animation reference and editorial material. On sale since 2026.

A child dummy is not a scaled adult, and that distinction cost lives to learn. Proportions, mass distribution and neck strength all differ, and child restraint standards exist because the tests were eventually run with the right instrument rather than a smaller version of the wrong one.

The model holds 31,797 polygons and 32,778 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 5 maps all at 4096x4096, and comes rigged for posing or animation. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a T pose build is offered separately.
At $119 it suits automotive safety visualisation, crash testing presentation, engineering and training material, child restraint marketing and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

The Haiying is the suit worn inside the spacecraft rather than outside it: lighter than an EVA suit, pressurised only if the cabin fails, and designed to be sat in for launch and re-entry. Most of the time a crew is in orbit, this is what they are photographed wearing.

The figure holds 72,312 polygons and 75,661 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 19 maps, 18 at 4096x4096 and one at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $119 it suits space programme visualisation, documentary and news graphics, museum and education work, film, game characters and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

A vibratory roller does not compact by weight alone. The drums shake at a frequency chosen for the material underneath, which packs asphalt far more effectively than static pressure and is why a small machine can do the work of a much heavier one.

The model holds 225,829 polygons and 236,834 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 18 maps, 4 at 8192x8192, 8 at 4096x4096 and 6 at 2048x2048. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and a rigged build is offered separately.
At $119 it suits construction and roadworks visualisation, equipment marketing, training and safety material, urban scenes and game environments. On sale since 2018.

A typodont is the model dentists learn on before they touch a patient, and with brackets fitted it becomes the orthodontist's whiteboard: the one object that explains to somebody what is about to happen in their own mouth over the next two years.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying the typodonts with brackets as static pieces. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $119 the set suits dental and orthodontic education, patient explanation material, clinic and product marketing, medical illustration and editorial work. On sale since 2025.

Fantasy costume borrows from real tailoring and then removes the constraints. A wrapped tunic over loose trousers is a genuinely practical combination that existed across Asia for centuries, which is why it reads as plausible even when the setting is entirely invented.
The garment set holds 33,300 polygons and 33,678 vertices in quads and tris with mixed UV layout, in green, and carries StemCell certification.
At $119 it suits game characters, fantasy film and animation, concept art and costume previsualisation, apparel visualisation and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

The M119 is light enough to be slung under a helicopter, which is the whole reason it exists. In battle position the trails are spread and dug in, the sight is set, and the gun stops being cargo and becomes a fixed point that the crew works around.

The model holds 215,027 polygons and 223,886 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 20 maps, 15 at 4096x4096 and 5 at 2048x2048, supplied in battle position. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $119 it suits defence visualisation and presentation, documentary and news graphics, simulation, film and game environments. On sale since 2019.

A motion simulator is a cockpit on a set of actuators, and the whole trick is that a short, sharp movement of the platform feels like sustained acceleration to the person strapped inside. The illusion is entirely in the timing of those legs.

The model holds 295,285 polygons and 154,851 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and comes rigged so the motion platform can be posed or animated. Native rigged builds for Maya and Cinema 4D are offered separately, and it carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $119 it suits simulation and training visualisation, aviation and entertainment equipment marketing, exhibition and trade show work, film backgrounds and game environments. On sale since 2024.

Sturgeon on ice is a specific commercial image. The fish is armoured rather than scaled, prehistoric in outline, and worth more than almost anything else on the counter, which is why it is presented whole rather than filleted.
The model holds 328,314 polygons and 334,975 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, supplying the fish together with its storage tray and ice. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $119 it suits food and seafood marketing, retail and restaurant visualisation, packaging and product presentation, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

Tilt rotors solve the argument between hovering and cruising by refusing to choose. The S-A2 concept puts that arrangement on an electric airframe sized for a short city hop, with the lighting treated as part of the design rather than as regulation.

The model holds 148,210 polygons and 151,570 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in white with the lights on. It is built to CheckMate specification, and the library carries several rigged builds around it, including native rigs for Maya and Cinema 4D.
At $119 it suits future mobility visualisation, technology and transport presentation, advertising, science fiction film, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A terminal is where the ship meets the pipe. Loading arms swing out over the jetty, the cold cargo transfers without ever touching air, and the tanks behind hold it until a grid somewhere needs it. It is the least visible part of the energy trade and the part everything else depends on.

The scene holds 365,191 polygons and 440,260 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, suited to the repeated pipework and tank structure. It is built to CheckMate specification, and further builds of the terminal are offered separately.
At $119 it suits energy and infrastructure visualisation, oil and gas presentation, port and logistics scenes, documentary and news graphics, and game environments. On sale since 2025.

The launcher is a set of angled canisters bolted to a deck, and that is deliberately all it is. The missile flies itself once out of the tube, so the ship needs nothing more than a frame that points roughly in the right direction and survives the exhaust.

The model holds 129,936 polygons and 133,857 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 24 maps all at 4096x4096, supplying the launching system with the missile. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $119 it suits naval and defence visualisation, documentary and news graphics, simulation, film and game environments, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2019.
